summary: A Yes vote authorizes bonds to repair and modernize school facilities in the Jamul-Dulzura Union School District.

tax.text: Opposes Measure H to prevent a property tax increase for the Jamul-Dulzura Union School District.
tax.quote: Imposes a new costly property tax despite massive levels of wasteful spending, giving government workers massive salary hikes and pension spikes, and awarding contracts to political supporters without fair and open competition.
